テキスト cha 306: Born Shiyo 757, June 11. Height 178cm (as of Shiyo 800). An engineer at a company that develops mobile phones. He often goes away on business trips, and Natsumi Kogori seems to be unhappy about it.

The flayed body was Ryoji Kogori. That being so, how he came to be killed, and why he lied about going on a business trip (a check with his workplace showed that no trip was scheduled at the time), are unknown.

On April 3 of Shiyo 800 he gave Natsumi Kogori, Haruka Niimura and Erina Goto the newest smartphone, which he had designed himself. A photograph of him clowning remains on Natsumi Kogori's phone, and it is the last photograph of him.

If Ryoji Kogori was killed in imitation of the Megasawa City case, Erina Goto thinks he had some link to that case. As evidence, Haruka Niimura's smartphone seems to have been modified somehow, and he is presumed to be involved in the flayed-body case.

Mifuyu Niimura asks (half forces) him to plant bugs in Haruka Niimura's and Natsumi Kogori's smartphones. His skills cannot meet the request, so he turns it to his advantage and plans to win Haruka Niimura back. Then, ready for the danger to himself, he decides to negotiate with Mifuyu Niimura.

He asks Mifuyu Niimura to return Haruka Niimura, but as expected she flatly refuses. He holds a trump card, the smartphone tampering, but the wary Mifuyu strikes first and kills him. Copying the Megasawa City case for maximum cruelty, she flays his whole body; he dies in agony, with no finishing blow.
He set up a meeting between Mifuyu Niimura and Eiichiro Niimura, but both were nervous throughout and the mood never relaxed, which kept him bewildered.

Two years after the accident that killed Eiichiro Niimura, he was living in Motoki-cho as before, but went on struggling with the problem of Natsumi Kogori's April sickness. He also makes a point of obeying Natsumi Kogori's warnings of danger.

In the Russian-roulette takoyaki match at Zahha, he thought almost comically of nothing but how to lose. Few adults would feed young girls a vicious spice, but since he never canceled the takoyaki, one could say he raises his daughter a little overprotectively.
Seeing the letter from Mifuyu Niimura, he concluded that either way Haruka Niimura's life was in danger too, and decided to go to Megasawa City.
He agonized over whether to take Natsumi Kogori to Megasawa City, but accepted her warning and decided to take her.

Stunned to find the Niimura household more destitute than he had imagined, he keeps negotiating to avoid the murder request at all costs. But Mifuyu Niimura stays a step ahead of him in every respect, and he begins to struggle with whether there is no choice but to carry out the killing.

Watching Natsumi Kogori with Mifuyu Niimura, he dimly grasps Mifuyu's true heart. Thinking they should give her what she truly wants instead of a murder, he and Akane Kogori hold back. But that evening Natsumi says something that rejects this, and he doubts whether he did right.
Pretending the murder has been carried out, he draws out of Mifuyu Niimura how she planned it. But this provokes Mifuyu Niimura's wrath; his family is slaughtered before his eyes, and he too dies.
激昂した新村美冬を止めようとした古郡茜を制止する。結果、古郡なつみをかばった新村春花がその攻撃を受けることになる。

When Natsumi Kogori asks about Eiichiro Niimura's death and its cause, he hurries to explain, but stops when he sees her apologizing to Mifuyu Niimura. At last, after seeing the shadow lift completely from Mifuyu Niimura's heart, he alone offers words of prayer to Eiichiro Niimura.

In Shiyo 800, though he is specially permitted to attend Eiichiro Niimura's thirteenth-year memorial service, he sends Natsumi Kogori in his place because of her warning. However, not knowing what danger awaits, he seems uneasy about sending his daughter to the Arata settlement.
やはり殺人が起こるかもしれない現場に娘を連れていくことはできないとの考えで、古郡なつみを連れて行かなかった。
Akane Kogori declares she will carry out the killing to save Mifuyu and Haruka Niimura. Ryoji Kogori hesitated to the end, but having come this far, he resolves to go to the grave with her.
He answers a call from Natsumi Kogori and tells her what happened in Megasawa. But right after, he and his wife Akane appear to be attacked by someone.

Ryoji Kogori and Akane Kogori, thought to have been killed, are dragged out alive by the residents before Natsumi Kogori and the others. Kotaro Niimura urges them to hand over Natsumi Kogori in exchange for sending the two back alive. But as the others hold her back, no hostage exchange happens.
Emboldened by drink, he barges into the family bath where Natsumi Kogori and Haruka Niimura are, but Haruka screams and drives him out.
To Natsumi Kogori, who has been isolated so that no information reaches her, he slips a hint about the situation. It shows how Necro is getting its information, and why Natsumi has been isolated.
